_purpose: Source feed for the audio-cue layer (§3.6) and the team-information channel. Discrete sound-emitting + comms events; continuous weapon-fire audio is not in this stream (it is reconstructed from the dense-input/usercmd path).

_audio_cue_taxonomy.item_gain: pickup sound at the item's world position (armor/health/ammo clink)
_audio_cue_taxonomy.powerup: QUAD/PENT/RING pickup — map-wide audible announce; the loudest single cue in QW (enemies hear quad taken)
_audio_cue_taxonomy.death|spawn: gib/pain/telefrag-respawn sounds at a world position
_audio_cue_taxonomy.chat: QW teamplay location/status callout channel — the team's information layer (not literal voice). Carries enemy-spotting (e.g. 'enemy quad'), self-status (hp/armor/loc), and item-loss reports.
